question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Basis**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Basis** means the foundation or fundamental principle on which something is built or established. (आधार या मौलिक सिद्धांत)

 
 
• **Example**: *The success of the project depends on a solid basis of thorough planning and strategic execution.*
 
 
 
• The sentence requires a noun that can fit logically into the blank.
 
• **Basis **is the most appropriate option in this context as it completes the sentence meaningfully.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Love**: Deep affection and emotional attachment toward someone or something. (गहरा स्नेह और भावनात्मक लगाव)
 
• **Counter**: To offer a response or argument in opposition to something. (विरोध करना)
 
• **Understanding**: The ability to comprehend or grasp the meaning, significance, or nature of something; mental comprehension. (समझदार)
